title: Figure 20. Atlas IIAS Mode-5 Ship-Hit Contours with A = 6.30
description: Contour plot of "Crossrange Distance (nm)" versus "Downrange Distance (nm)" showing elongated Mode-5 ship-hit probability contours at 10^-5 and 10^-6. In-plot labels read "Atlas IIAS," "Mode 5 P_I," and "B = 5,000,000, A = 6.30." The outer contour stretches to about 22 nm downrange.
